title: Backstop Project Manifest Schema v1
description: Schema for backstop.yml project configuration. Defines required and optional fields for project manifests.

language.description: RETIRED (SPEC-046): no longer read by backstop; a project is described by its declared packs, not one baked language. Retained as an allowed-but-ignored legacy key so an existing backstop.yml carrying it still parses cleanly; never required

artifact_root.description: PROJECT-RELATIVE directory holding the artifact chain (specs, plans, bundles, issues, directives, adrs, capabilities). ABSENT means the project root itself, marked unconfigured - the framework exception that keeps a repo-root layout working without configuring anything. An absolute value, or one escaping the project root, is rejected.

waiver_warning_days.description: Number of days before waiver expiry to warn

semgrep_version.description: Pinned semgrep version for reproducible scans

test_command.description: Explicitly declared test command for typescript/declared stacks (no package.json detection)

toolchain.description: Declared toolchain bindings: pass name (lint/build/test) to command + output format. Makes a stack data, not code.

format.description: Named output format parsing the tool's output (e.g. eslint-json, tsc, sarif, regex-lines)

test_dependency_command.description: Optional dependency-mapped test command; full-suite command is the fallback

gate_type.description: Traceability dimension this toolchain entry declares (substantiveness | coverage | contracts); presence with a matching value makes the dimension DECLARED for the SPEC-036 polarity classifier

waived.description: Opt the declared dimension out of its class-2 capability-absent advisory; silences ONLY the class-2 warning, never a class-1 or class-3 failure

policy.description: Per-dimension enforcement policy, keyed by gate dimension (the step/gate_type name, e.g. pack_engines, coverage_threshold). Each entry sets the enforcement level and which violations count (applies-to). The keys are backstop's universal dimension vocabulary — never a tool or language name.

level.description: Enforcement level: off (don't enforce), warn (surface, never fail), block (fail the gate on findings). Empty defaults to block.

applies-to.description: Which violations count: new-code grandfathers pre-existing findings against the baseline (block only net-new — the ratchet); all-code blocks on the TOTAL (zero tolerance). An ABSENT applies-to defaults to all-code (the strict floor — a bare dimension is never silently grandfathered).

sources.description: OPTIONAL per-PACK / per-rule-SOURCE override (SPEC-047 REQ-007), keyed by the pack/rule-source name. A source-scoped override applies its level+applies-to ONLY to that pack's findings within the dimension; every other pack keeps the dimension default.

level.description: Enforcement level for this source's findings within the dimension.

applies-to.description: Which of this source's findings count: new-code grandfathers pre-existing, all-code blocks on total (zero tolerance).

packs.description: Pack ref to version mapping (e.g. acme/go-standards: 1.0.0, or local for local packs)
